race.comment: GIOVANNA STAR (5) has the strongest current profile after a Mudgee win over Ilikesooboogie and a half-length second to Ole Miss at Goulburn last week when she finished strongly as favourite. The quick back-up and 1.5kg claim suit, and her form this season puts her right in this. AVOID ME (6) is the danger on toughness, beaten just under a length at Dubbo after a strong Open second at Harden. Each-way. HEMSTED (11) is the veteran with the deepest record, including three wins at this distance, and his last-start margin at Dubbo was still sound enough for this grade. BUSHWALKER (7) has a class-drop angle after Bathurst and her close third at this track two starts back gives her a genuine case if she sharpens late.
